title: Event envelope
description: One observation captured from the VTT during a live session (ARC-16, CAP-03; docs/contracts/foundry-bridge.md). One line of observations/<session>.jsonl in the workspace.

id.description: Unique id given by the connector when it captures the event; the Core keeps an id once per session, so a resent observation is never recorded twice.

session.description: The live session the event was captured in (moment.yaml's session); null for a kind recorded in every moment, such as a ceiling change (DEL-19a), captured outside a live session.

at.description: Real time the event happened, ISO 8601 with offset.

scene.description: The VTT scene it happened on (a Foundry UUID), or null.

actor.description: The actor it is about or spoken by (a Foundry UUID), or null.

kind.description: Generic kinds: chat, combat, scene, ceiling; clock and rules_context, filled by a system adapter. A System extension's kinds are prefixed by its system id (pf2e.strike) and their payload schemas ship with it.

visibility.description: Who saw it at the table: players (the whole table), gm (not shown to the table: GM-only, or whispered to some users, named in the payload), blind (hidden even from the roller). Only players attests what the party knows.

payload.description: The kind's content. chat: {author, speaker, text, flavor, whisper, rolls}; combat: {action, combat, round, turn, combatant}; scene: {action, name}; clock: {date, world_time}; rules_context: {foundry, system, system_version, modules, settings}.
